_note: Inputs the data cannot measure because Stories has never logged suggestions. Each has a low / base / high value. Notebook 05 shows how the answer moves across these ranges; a pilot replaces them with measured values.

base_acceptance.meaning: Share of customers who would NOT have added an item but accept a full-price suggestion of an average-appeal item. Items customers pick more often organically get proportionally higher acceptance.

discount_lift_per_10pct.meaning: Relative increase in acceptance per 10% off. Base is low because, in the data, a discounted first drink was not associated with more pairing (25.1% vs 25.7%, p = 0.65); this is observational, not a test.

switch_rate.meaning: Share of customers who were going to add a different item and switch to the suggested one.

offer_rate.meaning: Share of eligible orders where staff actually make the suggestion (till compliance).

staff_seconds_per_suggestion.meaning: Till time each suggestion adds (saying one line and tapping accept or decline).

staff_cost_per_hour_usd.meaning: Loaded hourly cost of counter staff. Not in the data; a placeholder Stories should replace with its own figure.
